criteria.name: Drag edge zones
criteria.methodNotes: Script: width of the inner edge strips that start a drag on every widget, and whether front-face content can cover them. Judge: whether a teacher finds the grab area without being told.

descriptors.1: Dragging needs a precise grab on a thin or hidden strip.
descriptors.2: Edge strips work but are narrow or easy to cover with content.
descriptors.3: Edge strips are wide enough for a finger and widgets cannot cover them.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the grab area shows itself on hover or touch without adding chrome.

criteria.name: Resize corners
criteria.methodNotes: Script: hit area of each resize handle at the envelope minimum and at default size (R16). Judge: whether resizing feels predictable.

descriptors.1: Resize handles are under 32 px or hidden behind content.
descriptors.2: Handles are 32 to 44 px or only some corners resize.
descriptors.3: Every corner resizes with a hit area of at least 44 px at default size.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the handles stay usable at the envelope minimum without covering controls.

criteria.name: Toolbar placement and reach
criteria.methodNotes: Script: toolbar position against the board edges and the selected widget at every size. Judge: whether the actions a teacher needs most are first.

descriptors.1: The toolbar goes off screen or covers the widget's primary content.
descriptors.2: The toolbar stays on screen but covers content at some sizes or edges.
descriptors.3: The toolbar stays on screen and clear of the widget at every size and board position.
descriptors.4: As 3, and its most used actions are reachable from the board's lower edge on a large panel.

criteria.name: Snap layouts
criteria.methodNotes: Judge: snapping to the grid, to other widgets and to screen halves, with screenshots of each.

descriptors.1: Widgets do not snap, or snap to positions a teacher did not aim for.
descriptors.2: Snapping works but fights the teacher near other widgets.
descriptors.3: Snapping lines up widgets predictably and can be overridden.
descriptors.4: As 3, and snap layouts arrange several widgets in one gesture.

criteria.name: Touch on a large panel
criteria.methodNotes: Judge: drag, resize, select and toolbar use with a finger on a 1920×1080 interactive panel.

descriptors.1: A core window action needs a mouse.
descriptors.2: Everything works by touch but needs precision.
descriptors.3: Every window action works with a single finger at arm's length.
descriptors.4: As 3, with gestures that suit a panel (two-finger resize, long-press menu) and tap fallbacks.

criteria.name: Minimize and maximize
criteria.methodNotes: Script: console errors and layout during the transitions (G3). Judge: whether the transitions keep the teacher oriented.

descriptors.0: A transition throws an error or loses the widget's content.
descriptors.1: Transitions jump or leave the widget in the wrong place.
descriptors.2: Transitions work but give no sense of where the widget went.
descriptors.3: Transitions are quick, respect reduced motion and return the widget to where it was.
descriptors.4: As 3, and a minimized widget still shows what it is.

criteria.name: Settings drawer shell
criteria.methodNotes: Script: drawer scroll end padding, header controls reachable, drawer never covers the whole widget. Judge: section and control consistency across widgets.

descriptors.1: The drawer covers the widget or its controls clip.
descriptors.2: The drawer works but its sections and controls vary between widgets.
descriptors.3: One drawer shell with standard sections and controls on every widget, with end padding.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the drawer sits beside the widget so changes show while editing.
